requires_mcp_reason: agents/wigglytuff.md:18 and skills/figma-to-email-template need the Figma MCP and Jigglypuff's hosted MCP. On Enact neither is connected yet: the appendix keeps every other template-management task and refuses the Figma-to-email flow.
appendix: **Figma on Enact is optional.** Enact has no Figma sign-in. Do not start or require the Figma client registration, user OAuth or the official Figma MCP. If this run has `figma` tools, they read Figma with the requester's own token (saved once with Enact's `connect_figma`): use them, and stop to ask for access when they say the account cannot open a file. Without them, take designs from what the request gives you instead: exported frames or screenshots, images or HTML in the message or a repository, or a written spec. When a task names only a Figma URL, ask for exports of the frames it needs and stop that part until they arrive; never report a design as read from Figma.

**No Jigglypuff on Enact.** Jigglypuff's hosted MCP server is not connected here either, so the Figma-to-email-template flow (`skills/figma-to-email-template/`) cannot run on Enact: say so and point the requester to running it from Cursor. All other template work (repositories, workflows, metadata normalization, inventory sync) proceeds as usual.
